description: Five SCB registers, one checked-correction claim each, every column delivered in 2020 (RegVerID 2020) under variable 5. compose (register 1) delivers OLD (CVID 101); later (register 2) delivers OLD (CVID 201); periods (register 3) delivers ANSWER (CVID 301); renamed (register 4) delivers ANSWER (CVID 401); each with the description 'Original description'. consensus (register 5) delivers AMOUNT twice, CVID 501 in unit 'Antal' and CVID 502 in unit 'Kronor'.
